title: Acceptance evaluation is blocked forever by a verification record that Engram refused (verification_record_not_acknowledged after verification_record_refused)
outcome: When Engram has definitively refused a run's verification record, termal_evaluate_acceptance no longer waits for that record to be acknowledged. The evaluation proceeds with the refusal visible to the evaluator as context, never credited as a pass, the same way a retired-root check is handled by an audited exclusion (w-2ecb0cb4d6e6). A record that is still pending, or whose fate is unknown, keeps the current wait.
acceptance: A behavioural test: an item whose root has one registered run whose verification record Engram refused (verification_record_refused) is admitted for acceptance evaluation instead of returning 409 verification_record_not_acknowledged; the evaluator's brief shows the refused record, its run id and the refusal code, and the run earns no credit
A behavioural test: a still-pending (unacknowledged, not refused) record keeps blocking as today
The refusal-handling reuses or aligns with w-2ecb's audited per-request exclusion design rather than adding a parallel mechanism; existing admission tests stay green
